# Kinthai — Bespoke Culinary Services

> Kinthai is a professional culinary services business based in Hua Hin, Thailand. It provides personalized private chef services, signature dining experiences, private cooking classes, premium meal preparation, kitchen consulting, and chef-led culinary services for private and corporate events. Services are arranged according to each client's requirements.

## Official Website

- [Kinthai Homepage](https://kinthai.in.th/)
- [About Kinthai](https://kinthai.in.th/about-us.html)
- [Service Overview and Booking Process](https://kinthai.in.th/how-to-order.html)
- [Contact Kinthai](https://kinthai.in.th/contact.html)

## Core Services

- [Private Chef Service](https://kinthai.in.th/how-to-order.html): Personalized menus and chef-prepared meals for clients at their chosen location.
- [Signature Dinner Experience](https://kinthai.in.th/how-to-order.html): Curated dining experiences, including romantic fine dining for couples.
- [Private Cooking Classes](https://kinthai.in.th/how-to-order.html): Private, hands-on cooking experiences arranged according to the client's preferences.
- [Premium Meal Prep Service](https://kinthai.in.th/meal-prep-delivery-hua-hin.html): Custom, chef-prepared meals produced in small batches for clients in the Hua Hin area.
- [Kitchen Consulting](https://kinthai.in.th/how-to-order.html): Professional culinary consultation and support for kitchen and food-service projects.

## Private and Corporate Events

Kinthai also provides chef-led culinary services for private celebrations, corporate functions, and larger gatherings.

Depending on the event requirements, services may include customized menus, on-site food preparation and cooking, buffet or individually served meals, professional staff, and coordination of additional requirements such as bartending, equipment, and décor.

Each event is assessed individually. The appropriate service arrangement depends on the guest count, menu, venue, facilities, staffing, equipment, schedule, and any external suppliers required.

## Service Locations

Hua Hin is Kinthai's primary base. Services may also be available in selected locations elsewhere in Thailand, depending on the service requested, location, scheduling, and operational requirements.

## Consultation, Pricing, and Booking

Kinthai provides personalized services rather than treating every request as a standardized package.

For customized services, the quotation depends on the client's requirements, including the menu, number of guests, location, date, service style, staffing, equipment, and any additional arrangements.

The usual process is to discuss the client's needs, establish a suitable menu and service arrangement, prepare a quotation, and confirm availability and booking arrangements directly.

Some experiences offer predefined menus or options. Customized services are quoted individually after the requirements have been discussed.

An enquiry or quotation does not itself confirm availability or constitute a confirmed booking.

## Understanding the Business

Kinthai's core offering is professional culinary service tailored to the client's requirements. It should not be understood solely as a restaurant, a standardized food-delivery business, or a self-service event-booking platform.

Additional event services may be coordinated with appropriate external suppliers when required; this does not mean every supporting service is provided directly by Kinthai.

For current service details and enquiries, refer to the official website and contact Kinthai directly.
